pages.text: The facility for casting $(bold)ritual spells$(). The currently available ritual spell is $(bold)Revive$(). Ritual spells are not auto-cast by wizards in combat and must be ordered at the altar.

$(li)Press $(bold)V$() to open the panel, then $(bold)aim your crosshair at the altar and right-click$() to open the Altar panel.$(li)The list shows castable spells; each row marks $(bold)name / mana cost / cooldown / channel duration$().$(li)$(bold)Single-click$() a row to select it (highlights only, does not cast).$(li)Click $(bold)Submit$() in the bottom right — the colony dispatches a wizard with enough mana to walk to the altar and cast; the magic circle unfolds at the altar's center.$(li)"Casting" is shown until the cast finishes; each altar keeps an $(bold)independent cooldown per spell$(), so they never interfere.
pages.title: Casting a Ritual Spell

pages.text: $(bold)Item  Description$()$(li)Target — The $(bold)most recently deceased wizard$() of this colony, regardless of where they died$(li)Effect — The wizard is reborn at the $(bold)altar's center$(), with name, appearance, attributes, and inventory restored$(li)Cost — The revived wizard is $(bold)weak$() — 1 HP and 0 mana, recovered through out-of-combat regeneration and mana regen$(li)Prerequisite — A death record must exist (death records are kept permanently, and only removed after a successful revive)$(br2)The altar needs a $(bold)living wizard$() to walk over and cast it. So a $(bold)total wipe stalls the altar too$() — when that happens, open the $(l:wandscape:townhall_guide)Town Hall$(/l); its $(bold)Revive Wizard$() button lights up.
pages.title: Revive

pages.text: $(li)Casting consumes the $(bold)performing wizard's$() mana; you can't submit while no colony wizard has enough mana.$(li)$(bold)Locked on publish$(): submitting locks the spell until the cast ends, preventing duplicate casts.$(li)Altar spells are not part of a wizard's auto-cast strategy and must be ordered at the altar manually.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:npc_guide)Wizard NPC Guide$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:strategy_guide)Cast Strategy Guide$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
